parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
SELECT si.id, si.person_key, si.platform, si.social_id, si.display_name, si.email,
       si.zoho_lead_id, si.zoho_contact_id, si.touches, si.reactivated,
       si.first_seen_at, si.last_seen_at,
       (si.platform = p.j->>'platform' AND si.social_id = p.j->>'social_id') AS matched_person_key
FROM nat130.social_identity si, p
WHERE (si.platform = p.j->>'platform' AND si.social_id = p.j->>'social_id')
   OR (COALESCE(p.j->>'email', '') <> '' AND lower(si.email) = lower(p.j->>'email'))
ORDER BY (si.platform = p.j->>'platform' AND si.social_id = p.j->>'social_id') DESC, si.last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO nat130.social_identity
    (platform, social_id, source_client, display_name, email, zoho_lead_id, last_external_id, last_post_id, last_message, consent_version)
SELECT j->>'platform', j->>'social_id', j->>'source_client', j->>'display_name',
       NULLIF(j->>'email', ''), NULLIF(j->>'zoho_lead_id', ''), NULLIF(j->>'last_external_id', ''),
       NULLIF(j->>'last_post_id', ''), NULLIF(j->>'last_message', ''), j->>'consent_version'
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) p
ON CONFLICT (platform, social_id) DO UPDATE SET
    display_name     = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, nat130.social_identity.display_name),
    email            = COALESCE(nat130.social_identity.email, EXCLUDED.email),
    zoho_lead_id     = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.zoho_lead_id, nat130.social_identity.zoho_lead_id),
    last_external_id = EXCLUDED.last_external_id,
    last_post_id     = EXCLUDED.last_post_id,
    last_message     = EXCLUDED.last_message,
    consent_version  = EXCLUDED.consent_version,
    touches          = nat130.social_identity.touches + 1,
    reactivated      = (nat130.social_identity.last_seen_at < now() - interval '30 days'),
    last_seen_at     = now(),
    updated_at       = now()
RETURNING id, person_key, zoho_lead_id, touches, reactivated, first_seen_at, last_seen_at
